root_cause: Prisma engine binary incompatibility with Alpine 3.23 musl libc + OpenSSL 3.x
symptom: libssl.so.1.1 missing for libquery_engine-linux-musl.so.node; symlink workaround failed

resolution.approach: Migrated from node:20-alpine to node:20-slim (Debian/glibc) for all Prisma-using containers

cascading_fixes.issue: PgBouncer should not run as root (newer versions refuse)
cascading_fixes.fix: Added pgbouncer user, USER directive, postgresql-client for healthcheck

cascading_fixes.issue: Unsupported startup parameter: search_path (Prisma vs pgBouncer 1.21)
cascading_fixes.fix: Upgraded pgbouncer to 1.22.1 (Alpine 3.20) and added ignore_startup_parameters

cascading_fixes.issue: Missing REDIS_URL env var, JWT_SECRET not set in shell
cascading_fixes.fix: Added REDIS_URL to docker-compose, created .env with JWT_SECRET
